notes.title: Minor Patch Fixes
notes.content:
Last night we pushed out a minor patch which fixes a few issues in the initial steam release.

They include the following fixes:

- Fixed bugs at tracks Buenos Aires, Londrina & Sta Cruz;
- Corrected mixing + adjusted several sound samples (fixing in particular the loud crash / scrape sounds)
- Included DX9 Setup files

- Minor update again to corrected bug with Dedicated exe
